mapper.insert: insert into sys_role( id , tenant_id, name , data_scope , status , menu_check_strictly , delete_flag , created_by , created_dt , updated_by , updated_dt ) values (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{dataScope}, #{status}, #{menuCheckStrictly}, 1, #{createdBy}, #{createdDt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedDt})
mapper.select: select distinct data_scope from sys_role where delete_flag = 1 and status = 1 and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id in (select role_id from sys_role_user where delete_flag = 1 and user_id = #{userId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId})

select distinct rd.dept_id from sys_role_dept rd join sys_role r on r.id = rd.role_id and r.delete_flag = 1 and r.status = 1 and r.data_scope = 5 where rd.delete_flag = 1 and r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.id in (select role_id from sys_role_user where delete_flag = 1 and user_id = #{userId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId})
